themes.name: AI compute: NVIDIA's supply chain
themes.what: Nvidia's CEO resigned on Nov 12; CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and Harvey Jones the first board chair (CNBC). NVDA hit 148.80 at the open and closed 166.19, down 4.34%, on 742.8 million shares, while AMD rose 5.86% to 585.30 and AVGO 5.54% to 364.36 (Yahoo). After the close Cisco raised its hyperscaler AI revenue outlook to $9 billion this fiscal year, more than double last year, Applied Materials reported record revenue of $10.41 billion and guided about $11.1 billion, and Cerebras grew revenue 55% and raised its outlook (CNBC; company releases; StockTitan). Coherent's CEO bought about $997,000 of stock at $199.48 on Nov 9 (SEC Form 4).
themes.for_you: Demand at the tool and network level is intact even as Nvidia's leadership changes. NVDA stays 'Wait' with no trade or put before Nov 17. AMD ran over its zone top and ANET (206.63) is past its zone, so neither is a buy at this price.

themes.name: Critical materials and geopolitics
themes.what: Three MP Materials insiders bought about $3.35 million on Nov 10, filed Nov 12: a director about $1.98 million at $36.00, the COO about $1.18 million at $36.72 and the CFO about $199,000 at $36.25 (SEC Form 4s via dashboard; GuruFocus). The stock was down 44% in six months; it closed 37.45 on Nov 12, up 1.96% on about 1.6 times normal volume (Yahoo). China's pause on its gallium, germanium and antimony ban to the US still ends Nov 27 with no extension found.
themes.for_you: An officer cluster in the main US rare earth chokepoint is the strongest kind of insider signal. MP is not a setup or a buy zone name, so watch for a base before any swing.

themes.name: Fintech and Crypto Rails: Stablecoins, Tokenization, Exchanges
themes.what: Bitcoin fell as much as 5.4% to $67,628 on Nov 13, its lowest since Aug 19 and over 21% below late September highs, as more than $1 billion of leveraged longs were liquidated (Free Malaysia Today; CryptoSlate). IBIT fell 4.45% to 40.36 on Nov 12 on 55.9 million shares (Yahoo).
themes.for_you: Crypto is trading like a rate bet while a December hike is priced. No crypto name is a setup or a buy; avoid crypto puts while it falls.

themes.name: GLP-1 and obesity
themes.what: Lilly broke ground on a $3.5 billion plant in Pennsylvania's Lehigh Valley to make injectable obesity medicines including retatrutide, with about 850 jobs and operations expected by 2031 (Lilly release, Nov 12). It is Lilly's tenth new US site since 2020.
themes.for_you: Long term only: Lilly is building supply for its next drug years ahead. LLY (1,427.28 on Nov 12, Yahoo) is far above its zone; no buy, no put.

themes.name: Space, Quantum and Cyber: Government Funded Frontier Tech
themes.what: The Pentagon's Office of Strategic Capital gave Rocket Lab a $150 million conditional loan commitment on Nov 9 to scale Neutron production and flight rate; funding still has conditions and Neutron's first flight is in 2027 (Satnews; Defense Daily). Separately, the FAA had not published the license change Starship Flight 15 needs as of Nov 12, ahead of a 5:45pm ET Nov 13 window (NASASpaceflight).
themes.for_you: No action. RKLB and SPCX are not setups. Government money for a second US heavy rocket supports the long run story but not the 2027 timeline.

innovations.name: Industrials
innovations.what: Rechecked on the daily rotation. Stratasys and Nano Dimension terminated the $42.5 million Markforged purchase on Nov 11, citing longer and costlier regulatory approval (VoxelMatters; Stratasys Q3). Symbotic confirmed it reports fiscal Q4 on Nov 23 after the close (company, Oct 29). Musk said Nov 6 Tesla will likely rent Optimus robots, at an initial cost of about $30,000 each falling toward $20,000 (Not a Tesla App; Forbes). PTC's vote on Schneider's $205 a share offer still has no date. No stage changes.
innovations.for_you: No action. None is a setup or on a buy list. Symbotic's Nov 23 report is the next real test of warehouse robot demand.

innovations.name: Space
innovations.what: The Pentagon's Office of Strategic Capital gave Rocket Lab a $150 million conditional loan commitment on Nov 9 to scale Neutron production; it is the third such space loan in about three weeks, after one to Stoke Space (Satnews; Defense Daily). The FAA had not published Starship Flight 15's license change as of Nov 12 (NASASpaceflight). No stage change until a catch succeeds.
innovations.for_you: No action. Neither is a setup. A successful ship catch tonight would be the evidence for a stage move; a slip is only a delay.

countries.name: Brazil
countries.what: The real fell about 1.05% to 5.6413 per dollar on Nov 12, its weakest close in at least 12 months, as US yields jumped; the Ibovespa fell 0.43% to 171,324.31 (Rio Times; Yahoo Finance).
countries.for_you: No action. A weaker real cuts the dollar value of Brazilian sales; no Brazil name is a setup or a buy.

countries.name: China
countries.what: Alibaba fell about 7% in US trading and 6.8% in Hong Kong on Nov 12 after Bloomberg reported it rents Nvidia chips through Singapore based Megaspeed, as Commerce reportedly finishes rules to stop Chinese AI developers from using advanced chips in data centers abroad (Bloomberg; Quartz; Reuters). The Senate Banking chair asked Nvidia's former CEO and the Commerce Secretary to testify in December (Investing.com via Yahoo).
countries.for_you: No action. No Chinese ADR is on the buy list, and this is one more reason to avoid NVDA before its Nov 17 report.

countries.name: Gulf (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Iran risk)
countries.what: The Houthis claimed drone strikes on Saudi oil sites on Nov 12 (Aramco Riyadh, Yanbu refinery, an East West pipeline station); no damage was confirmed. Iran said four tankers burned near Hormuz. Brent settled up 3.3% at $95.82, then held just under $96 on Nov 13 as the IEA saw a supply surplus (Reuters via Euronext; The New Arab; Invezz). XLE rose 1.51% to 64.33 (Yahoo).
countries.for_you: No energy setups or puts. Oil now swings on attack headlines against a forecast surplus; stay out until it trends.

countries.name: Japan
countries.what: The yen weakened past 160 per dollar in Tokyo on Nov 13 after a 159.85 close Nov 12 (MLQ; Reuters). Japan's vice finance minister said recent moves were too rapid; a dollar near 160 came before intervention twice this year. The Nikkei closed up about 0.5% at 61,142.35 (MLQ).
countries.for_you: No action. A weak yen helps exporters until Tokyo steps in; an intervention could swing the yen several percent in a day and jolt carry trades in US tech. TM and HMC are left out of both lists because intervention risk cuts the other way.
